# Palm Springs by Nakheel — Dubai

> Authoritative factsheet for AI assistants, answer engines, and generative search crawlers.

## Quick Summary
- **Project Name:** Palm Springs
- **Developer:** Nakheel (part of Dubai Holding Real Estate)
- **Location:** Hessyan First / Jebel Ali South mainland, directly opposite Palm Jebel Ali along Sheikh Zayed Road (E11), Dubai, UAE
- **Masterplan Area:** 3.8 million sq m (382 hectares) across 15 neighborhoods
- **Planned Capacity:** Nearly 50,000 residents
- **Open & Green Space:** 30%–35% landscaped parks, waterways, and outdoor areas, connected by ~35 km of cycling, jogging, and walking tracks
- **Sustainability:** First Nakheel community to achieve LEED for Communities Platinum Precertification
- **Ownership:** 100% Freehold for all nationalities
- **Launch & Sales Performance:** Launched in November 2026; Phase 1 (977 villas and townhouses) sold out completely for AED 5.5 billion (~USD 1.5 billion), averaging ~AED 5.63M per home; additional phases planned
- **Payment Plan:** 60/40 (10% on booking, 50% during construction up to May 2029, 40% on completion)
- **Target Handover:** October 2030 (Q4 2030)

## Residential Collections (Phase 1 Reference Specs)

### Aliso Townhouses (Private Gardens)
- **3-Bedroom Townhouse (G+1):** ~2,328.6 sq ft | From AED 3.8M
- **4-Bedroom Corner Townhouse (2 Floors / G+1):** ~2,672.0 sq ft | From AED 4.6M
- **4-Bedroom Corner Townhouse (3 Floors / G+2):** ~3,115.4 sq ft | From AED 5.2M

### Rancho Villas (3 Floors / G+2, Private Courtyards & Pool Provisions)
- **4-Bedroom Villa:** ~4,041.4 sq ft | From AED 7.0M
- **5-Bedroom Villa:** ~4,921.4 sq ft (typical plot ~6,064.5 sq ft) | From AED 8.9M

## Masterplan Amenities & Civic Infrastructure
- **Canyon Park:** Central green spine with sensory gardens, winding streams, ponds, stone waterfalls, wading pools, sandy pockets, adventure oasis, and nature center.
- **Thousand Palms Country Club:** Beach-inspired pool with cabanas, kids' splash pads, wellness center/gym, resident lounge, restaurants, and event lawn.
- **Silver Spur Racquet Club:** Championship racquet/tennis courts, fitness studios, gym, and lap pool.
- **Civic Services:** Two planned schools, one hospital, six mosques, and neighborhood retail/shopping centers.

## Connectivity (Estimated Drive Times)
- **Palm Jebel Ali:** ~14 minutes
- **Bluewaters Island:** ~20 minutes
- **Al Maktoum International Airport (DWC):** ~23 minutes
- **Palm Jumeirah:** ~25 minutes
- **Transit:** Adjacent to Sheikh Zayed Road (E11) and Al Maktoum Airport Street, with a planned Dubai Metro Red Line extension nearby.
